title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: New Orleans Lakefront (KNEW), STOL 77S & Night Lights!
description:
If you're looking to expand your flight routes and visual approaches, the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace just updated with an intriguing mix of historic coastal runways, grassroots short-field testing grounds, and massive night lighting enhancements. Whether you're hand-flying low visual approaches over water or flying redeye city routes, this week's drop offers focused additions for both VFR navigators and night cruisers!

In this scenery breakdown, we inspect all the latest airfield additions, architectural modeling details, STOL training facilities, and urban illumination upgrades to help you decide what's claiming top priority on your virtual SSD:

✈️ US WATERFRONT & SHORT-FIELD COMPETITION DESTINATIONS
We start on the shores of Lake Pontchartrain with New Orleans Lakefront Airport (KNEW)—formerly known as Shushan Airport, built in 1934 during the golden age of aviation as the "Air Hub of the Americas." We explore its custom PBR terminal architecture, realistic exterior weathering, detailed hangar facilities, custom ground polygons, adjacent marina harbor docks, and waterside approach lighting. Next, we head out west to examine Hobby Field (77S) "STOL Out West Light." We discuss this specialized short takeoff and landing competition field, its stripped-down lightweight performance footprint built for smooth framerates on lower-end PCs, and its practical rental/trial options for bush flying practice.

🌃 NOCTURNAL CITY & HIGHWAY MATRICES (DREAMSCENERY SERIES)
Looking to sharpen your after-dark visual approaches and nocturnal navigation? We inspect DreamScenery's extensive wave of night lighting enhancements across nine global destinations: Düsseldorf, Salt Lake City, Santander, Sacramento, San Antonio, Stuttgart, Portland, Providence, and Islamabad. We break down the crucial differences across these packages—from enhanced arterial road and highway matrices to full-scale, ground-up urban night illumination—so you know exactly what each upgrade adds to your simulator.

Which of these new additions are you loading into first? Lining up an Art Deco waterfront approach into Lakefront KNEW, putting your bush aircraft through its paces at Hobby Field, or lighting up your evening arrivals with new city night grids? Let us know in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you navigate the latest MSFS 2024 scenery additions, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
